artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 6.5-hour plan for a topic-scoped literature coverage-delta guard: extract literature-discover.sh's Tier 1 matcher into a shared literature-term-match.sh, add literature-coverage-delta.sh (parent_doc==null-filtered, compound gap+keyword condition, fail-open), downgrade literature-lit-flag-resolve.sh's SUBINDEX_PRESENT branch to the EXISTING SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED token on a topic-scoped miss, add a mandatory in-band [COVERAGE DELTA ...] banner plus delta_checked/delta_gap/delta_candidates marker fields to literature-briefing.sh repo mode, thread --query through lit-stage4a-flow.md's repo-mode call sites, add Section H fixtures (fires / negative control / chunk-inflation / not-computed / fail-open), and document the mechanism in sparse-coverage.md.

summary: Plan complete. All four design decisions the task required are settled explicitly: (D1) 'materially less' is a COMPOUND condition -- an absolute doc-level gap pre-filter (LITERATURE_COVERAGE_GAP_MIN, default 25) AND >= LITERATURE_COVERAGE_DELTA_THRESHOLD (default 1) keyword-matched global top-level documents absent from the sub-index; a bare ratio is explicitly rejected as alarm-fatigue noise. (D2) The delta is computed against keyword-matched entries only; the whole-index count is a pre-filter and a reported context field, never a trigger. (D3) One shared computation (new literature-coverage-delta.sh) with two wiring sites: the resolver's SUBINDEX_PRESENT branch and literature-briefing.sh's repo mode -- no new directive token, no new AskUserQuestion option set. (D4) Surfacing is BOTH: a mandatory, unconditional in-band [COVERAGE DELTA ...] banner inside lit_context (the only channel reaching orchestrator_mode=true runs) plus the existing four-option AskUserQuestion via the reused SPARSE_PROMPT_NEEDED directive in interactive contexts only. Two derived decisions are recorded with rationale: (D5) the delta deliberately does NOT overload sparse=true (different operator action; would leak into the mode=global two-checkpoint re-prompt grep) and instead carries its own marker fields plus an always-emitted banner, satisfying sparse-coverage.md's no-unconsumed-flag discipline by construction; (D6) an uncomputed delta reports delta_checked=false rather than a zero that could read as a verified clean result. The research report's parent_doc==null chunk-inflation gotcha is mandated in Phase 2 and pinned by a dedicated Phase 6 fixture case. The claim-level 'no counterpart exists' verifier is named explicitly in a '## Named Follow-Up' section and in Non-Goals as a /spawn candidate that this task does NOT close -- completion must not be reported as closing that risk class. Waves: [[1],[2],[3,4],[5,6],[7]]. All file targets are under agent-system/extensions/** per the source-store rule.
